param.name: seed.commit
param.spec: text label='Seed commit' description='Full SHA of the past master commit to build for the release archive' validationMode='not_empty' display='prompt'

parameters.param: REM Rebuild a past C++-era master commit for the monthly release archive (#4899). REM Jamroot.jam stamps the version date and git SHA from HEAD, so HEAD must be the REM seed commit itself, on a branch named master as in the original build. The VCS REM root enforces a depth-1 clone of the PR head, so fetch the seed commit by SHA; REM depth 1 is enough because the date and SHA both come from HEAD's own commit. if "%seed.commit%"=="" ( echo ##teamcity[buildProblem description='seed.commit is not set'] exit /b 1 ) git fetch --depth=1 --no-tags origin %seed.commit% || exit /b 1 git checkout -f -B master %seed.commit% || exit /b 1 REM Match the submodules to the seed commit too; tcbuild.bat fails a build that leaves the REM tree dirty, and a submodule left at the PR head's commit shows as modified git submodule update --init --recursive --force --depth 1 || exit /b 1 git clean -ffdxq || exit /b 1 git log -1 --format=fuller

REM Read version from build directory into PWIZ_VERSION set /p PWIZ_VERSION=<build-nt-x86\VERSION
REM Replace spaces with periods set PWIZ_VERSION=%%PWIZ_VERSION: =.%%
REM Pass the value to TeamCity echo ##teamcity[setParameter name='env.PWIZ_VERSION' value='%%PWIZ_VERSION%%'] echo ##teamcity[buildStatus text='%%PWIZ_VERSION%% from %seed.commit%']
